props.text: Live from the safety PLC - tap an isolation group to see only its devices

config.expression: if(try({view.custom.reset.text}, 'RESET ALL IGs') = 'RESET ALL IGs', 'RESET ALL IGs - ' + {view.custom.area}, try({view.custom.reset.text}, ''))

config.script:
# 1.2.0: RESET ALL IGs for the area on screen in one press - booth.safetyreset holds the area's HMI reset 3.5 s
	# (clears a safety fault), waits out the PLC's fault-reset pulse, then taps it 0.2 s (resets the groups).
	# It runs on the gateway, refuses a second press while one is running, and writes the HMI alarm history.
	booth.safetyreset.press(self.view.custom.area, self.session.props.auth.user.userName,
		'Safety Diagnostics popup %s' % self.page.props.path)

messageHandlers.script:
ig = str(payload.get('ig') or '')
	self.view.custom.ig = '' if ig == self.view.custom.ig else ig
